description.value:
The power is never owed; it answers strength. Attempt an Athletics check against the Call DC (your Call DC): 20 + 2 × attunement, 2 higher when the Ansu is hostile, 1 higher when it is cold, and 1 lower when it trusts you. You can't Invoke while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, while the Ansu holds your body, while it refuses you after a failed Call, or while a Call is still waiting for its roll.

  • Critical Success Communion begins for its longest length (10 rounds at Trial and Discipline, 100 rounds at Union).
  • Success Communion begins (3 rounds at Trial, 5 at Discipline, 10 at Union).
  • Failure The Ansu answers grudgingly. Communion begins for its shortest length (1 round at Trial, 2 at Discipline, 3 at Union), and the DC to send it back is 2 higher.
  • Critical Failure No Communion. The Ansu won't answer another Call for 1 minute, and you attempt the save to send it back at once.

Every Communion active materializes on your sheet alongside the buff and vanishes when it ends. Ending Communion, whether early or when it expires, takes a Will save against the Release DC (your Release DC). From attunement 2, a successful Invoke includes a free Stride (Bull's Footing). At Mastery the Call is no longer rolled.
